title: Understanding the Problem
text: The problem involves comparing two linear regression models: one using the original design matrix X and the other using the mean-centered design matrix X̃. Both models aim to minimize the sum of squared errors.

title: Mean-Centering Effect
text: Mean-centering the design matrix affects the intercept term in the linear regression model. Consider how this impacts the coefficients, especially the intercept.

title: Intercept in Mean-Centered Model
text: In a mean-centered model, the intercept term is typically zero because the mean of the predictors is zero. This is a key difference from the non-centered model.

title: Comparing Intercepts
text: What is the intercept term in the mean-centered model?

title: Conclusion
text: Given that the intercept in the mean-centered model is zero, consider how this affects the statement about \( \hat{\gamma}_0 \).
